Name: Shane Portrait HD-Redesign
Author: JoyZ8181
Description:
## Shane Portrait Redesign
This mod replaces Shane's portraits with a fully redrawn, expressive set while staying true to his personality.

### Features
- Full portrait replacement for Shane
- Expressive emotions
- Winter portraits included
- Beach portraits included
- Clean, high-quality anime-inspired style
- Content Patcher support (safe & removable)

### Versions[list]
[*]Content Patcher (MAIN file)[list]
[*]Automatically switches portraits by location (Beach) and events when applicable
[/list]
[*]Portraiture / PortraiturePlus (OPTIONAL file)[list]
[*]Allows switching portrait sets in-game
[*]Supports beach/winter variants if PortraiturePlus is installed
[/list]
[/list]
### Requirements
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher
- Portraiture + PortraiturePlus (for OPTIONAL version)

### Installation
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley /Mods folder

### Compatibility
- Compatible with most mods
- Not compatible with other Haley portrait replacers (unless patched)

### Notes
- This mod is completely optional
- If you don’t like AI-based or HD content, simply don’t use this mod
- Portrait sheets are always complete to avoid bugs or missing expressions

### AI Usage Disclosure
Portraits in this mod were generated by the author using AI tools and then manually selected and prepared for in-game use.

### Permissions
You may not reupload or modify this mod without explicit permission.

## Credits
Art and mod by: **JoyZ**
